facts.fact: Analyst Bright Simons of IMANI says Ghana's national AI strategy went through the ministry's review, cabinet approval and a high-profile media launch, and cites its computing targets of 2027 and 2035.

GHA.note: Cost figures are Simons' own modelling; no allocated public money is stated.

facts.fact: Bright Simons says a US$250 million AI data centre, to train and host the GhanaChat national AI platform, is now being procured by the Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations; the data centre and an AI Fund together are put at about US$270 million.
